rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when a person gets better after illness or injury.

example.english: His leg has started to recover.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zek3 goek3 hou2 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for regaining strength, energy, or a previously good physical or mental state rather than simply saying someone is well again.

example.english: After a few days' rest, my energy has started to recover.
example.traditional: 休息咗幾日，我嘅精神恢復返喇。
example.jyutping: jau1 sik1 zo2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 ge3 zing1 san4 fui1 fuk1 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when finding or getting back a lost physical thing, and it can also apply to locating a signal or sight again.

example.english: I finally managed to recover my glasses.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 faan1 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone regains physical footing or figuratively recovers control and composure after being unsettled.

example.english: After conceding two goals, we need to recover our composure first.
example.traditional: 輸咗兩球之後，我哋要穩返陣腳先。
example.jyutping: syu1 zo2 loeng5 kau4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 faan1 zan6 gok3 sin1
